title: Deep Tech to Space: Space Data Centers and AI Revolution at the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2605.19892v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dramatic cost reductions driven by private sector innovations have led to a rapid increase in the number of satellites in orbit and a corresponding surge in space-generated data. As this trend continues, transmitting large volumes of data to Earth for processing may become increasingly costly and challenging due to potential space-to-Earth link congestion and increased latency. Moreover, traditional ground station networks may face difficulties accommodating growing data flows and workloads because of capacity constraints, complex scheduling logistics, and restricted visibility windows, which can limit scalability. Space data centers (SDCs) -- software-driven, multi-tenant artificial intelligence-based service platforms capable of processing data in orbit to generate actionable insights for client satellites and ground users -- represent a promising approach to address these challenges.   This article presents the architecture

translated_title: 深度科技进入太空：太空数据中心与边缘AI革命
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.19892v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：私营部门创新所推动的成本大幅下降，导致在轨卫星数量迅速增加，太空产生的数据也随之激增。随着这一趋势的持续发展，由于潜在的空地链路拥塞和延迟增加，将大量数据传输至地球进行处理可能变得日益昂贵且充满挑战。此外，传统的地面站网络可能因容量限制、复杂的调度问题以及受限的可见时间窗口，而难以应对不断增长的数据流和工作负载，这可能限制系统的可扩展性。太空数据中心（SDCs）——一种软件驱动的、多租户的、基于人工智能的服务平台，能够在轨道上处理数据，为客户卫星和地面用户提供可操作的分析洞察——代表了应对这些挑战的一种有前景的方案。本文提出了该架构……
tldr: 本文提出太空数据中心（SDCs）这一新型架构，通过软件驱动的多租户AI服务平台在轨道上直接处理卫星数据，从而应对空地链路拥塞、延迟增加及地面站容量受限等挑战。
en_tdlr: This article proposes Space Data Centers (SDCs), a software-driven, multi-tenant AI-based service platform architecture that processes data in orbit, addressing challenges such as space-to-Earth link congestion, increased latency, and ground station capacity limitations.
